goal: Add an opt-in five-case thinker benchmark using the existing realworld runner and CSV reporting. Preserve comparability of the default suite.
requirements: hard_cases() returns (id, agent, setup, task, check) tuples. Use testing-code-reviewer, engineering-sre or engineering-technical-writer. Setups seed scratch files. Checks grade reply text offline.
Select only the hard suite in run() when BENCH_SUITE=hard. Otherwise use the base suite. Preserve BENCH_CASES filtering, CSV columns and ranking. Make REALWORLD_CASES 5 for hard, 16 otherwise.
hard_multifile_bug spans three Python files (~40 lines each); require root-cause file and function. hard_two_vulns seeds ~60 lines with two distinct vulnerabilities and requires naming both.
hard_ambiguous_trace seeds ~50 lines with a red herring and a KeyError; require the missing key. hard_long_summary seeds ~250 lines with three distinct numeric facts mid-document; require all three.

hard_compare_functions contrasts two similar functions, requiring the correct name and reason. Use tolerant case-insensitive checks. Add offline tests for correct and empty/wrong answers for all five.
context: Default cases in order: write_function fix_bug write_tests rename_across_files find_symbol review_sqli debug_trace summarize_readme role_analyzer role_data role_docs role_security role_designer role_browser role_tracker role_research. Keep the existing (bool, note) checker results. All five hard cases must reject an empty answer. Support the existing run_benchmark.py invocation with the hard suite environment and a separate CSV path.
